claim_boundary: CC BY year-end top-200 ranking memberships from 2007-2016, not bouts, touches, training interventions, or proof of athlete identity. The two sheets overlap by source athlete ID and are never added as independent people. Exact birth dates, direct source IDs, and full country names are removed. This older panel overlaps in years and concepts with the separately integrated 2004-2023 handedness ranking supplement, but the two cannot be entity-resolved safely without direct names and therefore are not row-counted together.
repository_policy: privacy-minimized CC BY row tables local; code and aggregates public
